rationale: Standalone ČNB prospectus register with its own update stream; in-scope supervisory register despite sitting on the wider cnb.cz domain.
ČNB MiCA/CASP news page carries dated licensing counts and hard deadlines — a leading indicator for the deadlines topic.
ESMA registers hub is a durable EU register layer showing CZ authorisations and passporting; monitorable on its own.
EBA supervisory disclosure and the PSD2 payment-institution register aggregate national data; core payments-scope cross-check.
ČNB FOI disclosure log is a recurring feed of register-derived statistics not otherwise published.
Single commentary article on ČNB 2025 supervisory stats; useful as evidence, the parent site (c_179) is the monitorable surface.
MF ČR banking-and-supervision section is the statute-level origin point for CZ banking/payments law and consultations.
Most on-point MF page for the payments act and PSD/PSR adaptation, with consultation notices and explicit comment deadlines.
MF press-release feed is the fastest dated signal that a banking/payments bill advanced; classic monitorable feed.
Monthly MF bulletin is a low-noise recurring digest that backstops missed legislative items.
A single dated press release about one annual report — high-value evidence for backfilling a legislative timeline, not a producing feed.
Government legislative work plan gives 6-24 months of forward visibility on planned banking/payments statutes and EU transposition.
Government meeting outcomes feed dates the gate between comment procedure and Parliament for each bill.
PSP sněmovní tisky is the authoritative, queryable bill tracker with dated stage histories; legal_status unclear is standard for a public state DB.
Plenary agenda calendar is the practical way to anticipate when a payments/banking bill is debated; distinct app from the tisky DB.
Senate document/tisk tracker covers the second-chamber window needed to date účinnost accurately.
e-Sbírka is the binding gazette giving promulgated text and entry-into-force dates — the anchor for any deadline calendar.
ISAP tracks EU acts to Czech implementation with transposition deadlines — directly answers when PSD3/PSR land in CZ law.
Chamber of Commerce comment tracker republishes every material with an explicit deadline; url_verification failed so re-check liveness before approving.
MF consumer-protection section repeatedly announces comment procedures for bills that also amend the payments and banking acts.
MF capital-market section carries the omnibus financial-market bills and dated consultation windows that routinely touch banking.
Historic consultation archive — mine once to learn MF consultation patterns and lead times, then archive.
Practitioner commentary hub that decodes MF drafts within days; secondary interpretation layer, always resolved back to primaries.
Low-credibility aggregator that mirrors MF notices; only worth keeping as a redundancy channel if mf.gov.cz crawling proves unreliable.
MF satellite literacy portal duplicates main MF notices with far lower value; covered by monitoring the MF sections already approved.
Legislative rules of the government define the mandatory bill-package structure — mine once to build extraction rules, not a recurring signal.
